verdict.rationale: Box is a cloud storage product, so published storage pricing is a fair question to ask. The pack contains no public pricing page, no per-plan storage quotas, no per-user prices, and nothing on what happens at the storage cap. The only plan-limit mentions are community anecdotes about free-tier file-size and bandwidth limits, which are not published pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, storage pricing is published — per-plan storage quotas and per-user prices on a public page, including what happens at the cap
